title: Traffic Policy parity deepening: traffic-policy + qos policy structured editors
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes scoped `/vyos/qos` config-tree wrapper endpoints without replacing existing VyOS service architecture.
`/network/traffic-policy` supports both `traffic-policy` and `qos policy` trees with structured form inputs (no free-form command text entry).
Save path emits scoped diff-based set/delete operations for both trees.
Validation passes: backend test_app, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: This slice covers high-value policy-level QoS options; class-level QoS subtrees remain additive follow-up work.
Interface-level policy assignment remains under interface configuration pages.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added thin config-tree wrapper router for qos under existing API model.
Implemented combined traffic-policy + qos policy form editors and diff-based saves.
Validated backend route import and full frontend runtime smoke gates.
Manual review completed; no blocking issues found.
